svg.aria-label: Numerical ranges and the Crouzeix ratio
svg.text: numerical ranges W(A) of three non-normal matrices
Crouzeix: ‖p(A)‖ ≤ 2 · max over W(A) of |p|. Dots are eigenvalues; the table lists the ratio ‖p(A)‖ / max_W |p|.
largest ratio here 2.000, reached by p = z on matrix 1; never above 2
